params.caption: 🖥️ Gears of War: E-Day streams up to 3.7 GB/s from your SSD to save RAM Tom's Hardware tested the storage tech behind Gears of War: E-Day and found it streams assets from the SSD at up to 3.7 GB/s. That saves several gigabytes of system RAM, helping the game's dense, detailed world run on PCs with more limited hardware. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 18:30 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @Xbox 💾 Running it off an NVMe? 👍 if yes · 💬 share your specs #GearsOfWar #EDay #SSD #PCGaming #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
